summary: Prisma Client migration is complete and fully verified across static, domain, PostgreSQL, build, and smoke layers.
findings: No direct pg dependency/import, Pool type, or Prisma raw API outside the shared database package remains; all prescribed checks pass.
evidence_refs: pnpm run quality; pnpm run test:property; pnpm run test:integration; pnpm run test:e2e; pnpm run test:load; pnpm run test:runbook; pnpm run build; pnpm run smoke:built; pnpm run verify:database-architecture
residual_risks: Complex PostgreSQL-only locking and bulk primitives remain raw by necessity, but execute exclusively through the shared Prisma database boundary and are covered by concurrency integration tests.
